properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued July 24 at 11:41AM EDT until July 24 at 1:45PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
properties.description:
SMWMHX

The National Weather Service in Newport has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
S of Cape Lookout NC to Surf City NC out to 20 NM...
S of Ocracoke Inlet NC to Cape Lookout NC out to 20 NM...
Waters from Cape Lookout  to Surf City NC from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 145 PM EDT.

* At 1141 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from near Ar340 to
6 nm southeast of Surf City, moving southeast at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Northwest Places, Ar340, Ar330, Ar342, R-8 Buoy, Ar355, Ar345, The
Knuckle Buoy, and Big Ten Fathom.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
properties.area: S of Ocracoke Inlet NC to Cape Lookout NC out to 20 NM; S of Cape Lookout NC to Surf City NC out to 20 NM; Waters from Cape Lookout  to Surf City NC from 20 to 60 NM

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Dangerous flows over low-water crossings.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 845 PM AKDT, river gauge and social media reports indicate
rises in water levels from heavy rain across the advisory
area. Minor flooding is expected, especially near Willow
Creek, Sheep Creek, Kashwitna River, Montana Creek and their
tributaries.
- For Willow Creek at Parks Highway:
At 8:26pm the stage was 9.0 feet.
Flood Stage is 10.0 feet.
Forecast: A crest around 11.0 feet is expected around 4:00pm
Thursday.

- For Willow Creek near Willow:
At 8:15pm the stage was 4.1 feet.
Flood Stage is 5.9 feet.
Forecast: A crest around 5.9 feet is expected around 10:00am
Thursday.
- Water levels on other rivers, creeks, or streams in the
advisory area, including Montana and Sheep Creeks and
Kashwitna River, may reach or exceed bankfull and remain
elevated through Thursday.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
